name: Pearl Talisman
description: Every tile in hand: melds including this tile score +100 chips.

name: Gilded Talisman
description: Every tile in hand: melds including this tile score +$1 gold.

name: Polychrome Talisman
description: Every tile in hand: melds including this tile score ×1.25 mult.

name: Souzu Talisman
description: Every numbered tile in hand becomes souzu; This transformation excludes honors and flowers.

name: Pinzu Talisman
description: Every numbered tile in hand becomes pinzu; This transformation excludes honors and flowers.

name: Manzu Talisman
description: Every numbered tile in hand becomes manzu; This transformation excludes honors and flowers.

name: Honors Talisman
description: Every numbered tile in hand becomes a random honor; This transformation excludes honors and flowers.

name: Wildflower Talisman
description: Every tile in hand becomes a flower.

name: Conformity Talisman
description: Every tile in hand becomes a copy of a random tile in your hand.
